purpose: no-regression guardrail after adding domain specialists

tps.overall_guardrail: adding TPS/specialist layer must not degrade seven-cell overall performance

family_context_probe_policy: family-finetuned EnzymeCAGE reaction features are used only to route to the corresponding family specialist; they do not modify the general functional/structural router directly

domain_specialization_policy.meaning: P450, phosphatase, CAGE-terpene and TPS are all present in the final system for every query; their contribution is zero unless their own applicability gate admits the query
domain_specialization_policy.cage_family_gate: reaction-only applicability selector followed by agreement with reaction-family and pair-level family decisions
domain_specialization_policy.official_family_tests: measure whether each family specialist is useful in the scenario it is designed for
domain_specialization_policy.overall_test: measures the whole integrated system with all specialist gates active
